title: The normalized matrix 2-norm is strictly below 1226/625 and below 19^10 (no new κ)
body:
## Summary
- At `p=19`, `beta0=-1/2`, bandwidth 2, and `t_i=i`, every absolute row sum and every absolute column sum of the normalized Schur section on `0,1,2,7,8,9` is strictly below `1226/625`.
- The 2-norm is therefore strictly below `1226/625`, which is strictly below `2` and strictly below `19^10 = 6131066257801`.
- No new kappa is claimed. The selected record is unchanged. This is one normalized section, not the note's all-size 2-norm envelope.
